content.short: Blockchaingames creates CNFT MOBILE GAMES on IOS/ANDROID.
content.description:
Blockchaingames made the first API request for a CNFT through UNITY. We were the first company to release a CNFT app on IOS and Android.

As a company, our goal is to create as many games as possible to grow the Cardano ecosystem and contribute to increasing awareness in the general gaming world and blockchain gaming world. Our CNFTs are also the only way to own our BCG tokens that represent our company.
